WITH camp AS (
  SELECT c.id, co.name AS empresa, c.name, c.created_at FROM campaigns c JOIN companies co ON co.id = c.company_id
  WHERE c.created_at > now() - interval '6 months' AND c.sent_count >= 20 ORDER BY c.created_at DESC LIMIT 16
),
rec AS (
  SELECT cr.campaign_id, cr.lead_id, cr.phone, cr.sent_at FROM campaign_recipients cr JOIN camp ON camp.id = cr.campaign_id
  WHERE cr.status = 'sent' AND cr.sent_at IS NOT NULL
),
r2 AS (
  SELECT rec.*,
    EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM wapi_conversations w JOIN wapi_messages m ON m.conversation_id = w.id
            WHERE w.lead_id = rec.lead_id AND m.from_me = false AND m.timestamp > rec.sent_at AND m.timestamp < rec.sent_at + interval '3 days') AS respondeu,
    EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM company_events e WHERE e.lead_id = rec.lead_id AND e.status <> 'cancelado'
            AND coalesce(e.data_fechamento_venda::timestamp, e.created_at) > rec.sent_at AND coalesce(e.data_fechamento_venda::timestamp, e.created_at) < rec.sent_at + interval '45 days') AS fechou,
    (SELECT l.status::text FROM campaign_leads l WHERE l.id = rec.lead_id) AS status_hoje
  FROM rec
)
SELECT camp.empresa, camp.name AS campanha, to_char(camp.created_at, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS criada,
  count(r2.campaign_id) AS enviados, count(*) FILTER (WHERE r2.campaign_id IS NOT NULL AND r2.lead_id IS NULL) AS sem_lead,
  count(*) FILTER (WHERE r2.respondeu) AS responderam_3d, count(*) FILTER (WHERE r2.fechou) AS fecharam_45d,
  (SELECT string_agg(x.s || ':' || x.n, ' ' ORDER BY x.n DESC) FROM (SELECT coalesce(r3.status_hoje, '-') AS s, count(*) AS n FROM r2 r3 WHERE r3.campaign_id = camp.id GROUP BY 1) x) AS status_hoje
FROM camp LEFT JOIN r2 ON r2.campaign_id = camp.id
GROUP BY camp.id, camp.empresa, camp.name, camp.created_at
ORDER BY camp.created_at DESC
